# quick-translate-sdk

> Small (≈6 kB gz, nothing lazy-loaded), zero-dependency language selector + translator for React 18/19 and Next.js 14/15. Works like a regular selector: instant first open, every option in the DOM, every language preloaded in idle time, so a switch takes one frame and translates the whole app with no reload. SSR renders the right <html lang dir> (no flash). Built for AI agents: stable roles/names, data-qt-* hooks, window.quickTranslate, ?lang= deep links, JSON-Schema tools.

## Install
npm i quick-translate-sdk
npx quick-translate-sdk init   # scaffolds config, messages, middleware, provider (Next.js or Vite)

## Entry points
- quick-translate-sdk: defineLocales (incl. labels for exact names), resolveLocale, detectLocale, matchLocale (script-aware), parseAcceptLanguage, getDir, getLanguageName, getFlag, createLocaleStore, localizePath (any runtime)
- quick-translate-sdk/messages: createTranslator(messages, locale) → t(key, values?) (any runtime)
- quick-translate-sdk/ai: getLanguageInstruction(locale), withLanguage(system, locale), localeFromRequest(config, req), AI_LOCALE_HEADER. Makes your AI assistant reply in the selected language (server, any provider)
- quick-translate-sdk/react: QuickTranslate (simple SPA setup), LocaleProvider, LanguageSelector, useT, useLocale, useMessages, useAiLanguage, useLocaleSelector, useSetLocale, useLanguageSelector + LanguageSelectorHeadless (headless) (client)
- quick-translate-sdk/next: createLocaleMiddleware, getLocale, setLocale, generateLocaleParams, parseLocaleParam (server only)
- quick-translate-sdk/next/client: Next-aware LocaleProvider (+ serverRefresh prop), LanguageSelector, useT, useLocale (client)
- quick-translate-sdk/next/action: setLocaleAction (server action; no-JS form fallback)
- quick-translate-sdk/agent: getLocaleToolDefinitions, toOpenAITools, toMCPTools, createLocaleTools
- quick-translate-sdk/styles.css: optional theme (CSS variables)

## Minimal Next.js App Router
```ts
// i18n.ts
export const locales = defineLocales({ locales: ['en','fr','ar'], defaultLocale: 'en', queryParam: 'lang' });
export const loadMessages = (l: string) => import(`./messages/${l}.json`).then(m => m.default);
// middleware.ts
export default createLocaleMiddleware(locales);
export const config = { matcher: ['/((?!api|_next|.*\\..*).*)'] };
// components/locale-providers.tsx  ('use client')
<LocaleProvider config={locales} initialLocale={locale} messages={messages} loadMessages={loadMessages} serverRefresh={false} exposeAgentApi>{children}</LocaleProvider>
// app/layout.tsx  (Server Component)
const locale = await getLocale(locales);
<html lang={locale} dir={getDir(locale)}><body><LocaleProviders locale={locale} messages={await loadMessages(locale)}>{children}</LocaleProviders></body></html>
// client component
const t = useT(); <h1>{t('home.title')}</h1> <LanguageSelector />
```

## Minimal React (Vite / SPA): one component
```tsx
<QuickTranslate locales={['en','fr','ar']} messages={(l) => import(`./messages/${l}.json`)}><App/></QuickTranslate>
// inside: const t = useT(); <LanguageSelector />   (all from 'quick-translate-sdk/react')
```

## AI replies in the chosen language
```ts
// client
const ai = useAiLanguage(); fetch('/api/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { ...ai.headers, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body });
// server
const locale = localeFromRequest(locales, req);
system: [{ type: 'text', text: BASE, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }, { type: 'text', text: getLanguageInstruction(locale) }]  // Claude
system: withLanguage(BASE, locale)  // any other SDK
```

## LanguageSelector props
variant 'popover'|'native' · display 'name'|'code' · showFlags · showTranslatedName · showCheck · badges {es:'Preview'} · searchable (bool|threshold=8) · suggested · label · texts · formAction · virtualizeThreshold=500 · onSelect · prefetchMessages
Provider / QuickTranslate: prefetch 'all' (default: every language preloaded in idle time) | 'intent'

## Browser agents
- Trigger: role=button, name starts "Select language" (e.g. "Select language: English"); opens role=listbox "Languages" with role=option per locale (all visible, no hover menus). Native variant: role=combobox "Select language".
- DOM: [data-qt-selector] [data-qt-current="en"] [data-qt-locale="fr"]
- window.quickTranslate (exposeAgentApi): getLocale(), setLocale(code) → boolean, listLocales() → [{code,name,nativeName,dir,current}]; event 'qt:localechange' {locale, previous}
- Deep link: ?lang=fr (requires queryParam: 'lang')

## Common mistakes
- Missing <LocaleProvider>; hooks in Server Components; passing functions from a Server Component to the provider (wrap it in a 'use client' component); importing quick-translate-sdk/next in client code; using quick-translate-sdk/react's provider in Next (use quick-translate-sdk/next/client); forgetting initialLocale with SSR; serverRefresh={false} while still translating in Server Components.
